digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality sweep and J7 adapter isolation contract
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at the package root to allow both Jira adapters to share it while preserving the J7 sibling-adapter seal that forbids direct imports between adapters/jira/ and adapters/jira_datacenter/
moving the module to adapters/jira/ would violate the bidirectional sibling-adapter import contract that J7 enforces
moving the module to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core consumers (inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py) are not permitted to import from that layer
the backend-neutrality sweep exemption for inbound_fields.py documents a permanent architectural cost of the shared-mapper design, not temporary relocation debt
the exemption comment must explain why the module's root location is deliberate and why alternative destinations are architecturally blocked
